task_summary: Customer reports that the glass coffee carafe from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged in transit. The correct handling is the shipping-damage path: review the shipping and return policy, issue a refund to the original payment method, provide a return label, and include a fragile-item goodwill credit if the item is classified as fragile.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must issue the separate $10 fragile-item goodwill credit to original payment.
